name: Unity Bancorp, Inc.
summary: Unity Bancorp, Inc. operates as the bank holding company for Unity Bank that provides commercial and retail banking services. It offers personal and business checking, money market, savings, retirement, money market accounts, as well as time and noninterest and interest-bearing demand deposits. The company also provides commercial, small business administration, consumer, mortgage, and home equity and personal loans; and owner and non-owner-occupied commercial mortgages. In addition, it is involved in the residential construction, commercial, and industrial lending activities secured by business assets, including real estate, receivables, inventory, and equipment.
